The country also faces challenges managing surplus imported LNG despite household fuel shortages.

articles.title: 'We Took Over Venezuela': Trump Claims Caracas Gifted Him A Million Barrels Of Oil
articles.description: President Donald Trump has claimed that Venezuela sent him a gift of one million barrels of oil following what he described as the successful US takeover of the country. Speaking to reporters before departing for Texas, Trump said, "We took over Venezuela very successfully," before revealing that Venezuela had sent him a million barrels of oil. "I'm giving that to the United States," Trump added. He also predicted that oil prices would drop sharply in the near future. The remarks drew attention to Trump's claims about Venezuela, the reported oil shipment and its potential implications for US energy supplies.
